'''Keith Stewart Thomson''' (born 1938; B.SC. Birmingham, AM, Ph.D. Harvard) was from 2003 to 2012 a senior research fellow of the [[American Philosophical Society]]<ref>[http://keithsthomson.com/bio.html Keith S. Thomson – Bio]</ref> and is, starting in 2012, the Executive Officer of the American Philosophical Society<ref>[http://www.amphilsoc.org/about/exec Keith Stewart Thomson, Executive Officer, American Philosophical Society]</ref> and is an emeritus professor of natural history at the [[University of Oxford]].<ref name="American Scientist Online">{{cite web |url=http://www.americanscientist.org/authors/detail/keith-thomson |title=American Scientist Online }}</ref> He was appointed director of the [[Oxford University Museum of Natural History]] in July 1998.<ref name="Oxford University Gazette">{{cite news |url=http://www.ox.ac.uk/gazette/1997-8/weekly/150198/notc.htm#5Ref |title=DIRECTORSHIP OF THE OXFORD UNIVERSITY MUSEUM OF NATURAL HISTORY |date=15 January 1998 |work=[[Oxford University Gazette]] |archive-date=13 August 2010 |access-date=2 January 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100813075719/http://www.ox.ac.uk/gazette/1997-8/weekly/150198/notc.htm#5Ref |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1987 he was appointed president of the [[Academy of Natural Sciences]] in Philadelphia. He had earlier been a dean at [[Yale University]] and director of Yale's [[Peabody Museum of Natural History]].<ref name="Philadelphia Inquirer">{{cite news |url=http://nl.newsbank.com/nl-search/we/Archives?p_product=PI&s_site=philly&p_multi=PI&p_theme=realcities&p_action=search&p_maxdocs=200&p_topdoc=1&p_text_direct-0=0EB95EB01078963B&p_field_direct-0=document_id&p_perpage=10&p_sort=YMD_date:D&s_trackval=GooglePM |title=Getting Its Man: Science Academy at Last has a New President |date=January 21, 1987|pages=D01 |work=[[Philadelphia Inquirer]] }}</ref>
He is the author of several books and essays that deal with [[paleontology]], the [[history of science]] and [[evolution]].
